verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a passing mention that Vanta's API can automate evidence collection/testing for 'security awareness training' as one of many system categories (vanta-docs-32); there is no documentation of on-hire assignment, completion tracking, or explicit audit-evidence acceptance workflow for training specifically.
